                      SELECT OLD.session_id,fingerprint,1 FROM conversation_semantic_state
                      WHERE session_id=OLD.session_id GROUP BY fingerprint
                      ON CONFLICT(session_id,fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET source_revision=source_revision+1;

                      SELECT session_id,fingerprint,OLD.seq,source_revision FROM conversation_semantic_state

                      SELECT m.session_id,s.fingerprint,m.seq,s.source_revision FROM agent_session_context_messages m

                      WHERE m.session_id=OLD.session_id AND OLD.trace_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND m.trace_id=OLD.trace_id AND m.role='agent'

ports.expression_index: idx_agent_runs_parent_run_id is represented by an invisible generated JSON scalar column plus a nonunique index
ports.text_keys: All other indexed SQLite TEXT fields used in a unique/primary key are converted to bounded VARCHAR at the InnoDB composite-key byte budget with CHECK constraints; nonunique text indexes use safe prefix indexes with postfilter; no prefix unique indexes are used. `memory_sources`, `knowledge_documents`, and `mail_sync_state` long composite unique keys use generated SHA-256 keys for every unbounded text component with collision-guard triggers; the full source tuple is retained in metadata.
ports.fts: FTS5 virtual tables and their 25 shadow tables are delegated to the native fulltext bootstrap; external FTS triggers are source-metadata-only
